beats.desc: the tip of a blue-handled screwdriver seats into the lower screw of the black latch faceplate on the edge of the white door and begins turning it clockwise to drive it in, while the other hand steadies the door edge
the screwdriver keeps turning and the screw sinks flush, seating the black latch faceplate tight against the edge of the door
beats.constraint: the screwdriver tip stays engaged in the latch faceplate screw and both hands stay at the door edge.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt drives the screws that fasten a black latch faceplate into the edge of a white door using a blue-handled screwdriver, working with both hands; the man
scene_keep: the white door with its round bored latch hole showing brass inside, the black rectangular latch faceplate on the door edge, and the bright sunny porch with a white railing and pale washed-out background behind
